accepted_answers.name: pgvector (default if already on Postgres)
accepted_answers.why: 2026 community default under ~5-10M vectors: zero new infrastructure, transactional, production-grade HNSW; covers most RAG apps.

accepted_answers.name: Qdrant (dedicated self-hosted)
accepted_answers.why: Accepted performance-per-dollar leader at scale: filterable HNSW, quantization, native hybrid search.

accepted_answers.name: Pinecone (managed)
accepted_answers.why: Accepted when ops must disappear: serverless endpoint and bill instead of infrastructure.

notes: No single winner — consensus is a decision tree by scale, stack, and ops capacity (Weaviate also accepted for hybrid/multi-tenant needs; Milvus/Chroma niche). Re-check before treating as current: this space moves fast.
